mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing discount rates applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive forward returns in the S&P 500 over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% over a 3-month window signals weakening labor market conditions, which increases the probability of central bank rate cuts and triggers a positive re-rating of equities over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative or flat 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 4.5% for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts below 1.1 million units in a single month signals a contraction in residential investment, which typically precedes a broader demand slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances despite HOUST < 1100.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production below 104.0 for two consecutive months indicates a weakening in real economic output, which increases the likelihood of monetary policy accommodation and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO remains below 104.0 for two months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in both residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicate a broad-based demand contraction, which increases the probability of aggressive monetary easing and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative or flat in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST < 1100.0 and RSAFS < 470000.0 simultaneously.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 2.5% and the federal funds rate is below 1.5%, the central bank is perceived as behind the curve, increasing the likelihood of future rate hikes and triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5 and FEDFUNDS < 1.5.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in unemployment (UNRATE) above 4.5% and a decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 146,000 signals a labor market deterioration that increases the probability of rate cuts, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative or flat in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 4.5 and PAYEMS < 146000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in real GDP (GDPC1) below 1.5% annualized growth over two consecutive quarters signals a deepening recession, which triggers a flight to safety and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where GDPC1 < 1.5 (annualized) for two consecutive quarters.
